name: native-storage
description: Proof (#1052): the owner's own storage library, called from trusted routes, with auth: true and no store extension.

scripts.validate: urlcode validate --local --project app --host-file host.mjs --policy operator/policy.json --origin http://localhost:4200
scripts.test: urlcode test --project app --host-file host.mjs --policy operator/policy.json --origin http://localhost:4200
scripts.audit: urlcode audit --expect-routes 3 --project app --host-file host.mjs --policy operator/policy.json --origin http://localhost:4200
scripts.start: urlcode serve --project app --host-file host.mjs --policy operator/policy.json --origin http://localhost:4200 --port 4200
